title: Classifying Argumentative Relations Using Logical Mechanisms and Argumentation Schemes
reasoning: The paper investigates 'normative relations' and 'practical reasoning' (using Walton’s argumentation schemes) to classify argumentative stances. It benchmarks its methods on datasets containing moral and ethical debates (e.g., abortion, hate speech) and a 'God' domain (10% of the Kialo dataset), evaluating how systems handle moral and religious logic.
